name: crm-project
description: Nova CRM monorepo — run backend and web from the root

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run db:push --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix web
